key_impacts: Shaking of intensity IV–VI/V–VII reported in Pacific coastal areas
PHIVOLCS issued tsunami alert level 3 with immediate evacuation
Coastal residents in Eastern Samar and Leyte conducted evacuations
Estimated ~80% of surveyed barangay residents evacuated
No significant tsunami observed; no damages reported
evidence_snippets: On 31 August 2012 a strong earthquake occurred in the Philippine Trench east of Eastern Samar.
At 09:01 pm PHIVOLCS issued alert level 3, meaning immediate evacuation.
All surveyed barangays had an estimated average of 80% of the residents evacuating after the alert.
missing_information: Precise list of hardest-hit settlements not detailed
No damage figures; tsunami impacts minimal
